subject: Computação
description_pt: Construir soluções computacionais de problemas de diferentes áreas do conhecimento, de forma individual e colaborativa, selecionando as estruturas de dados e técnicas adequadas, aperfeiçoando e articulando saberes escolares. Construir e analisar soluções computacionais de problemas de diferentes áreas do conhecimento, de forma individual ou colaborativa, selecionando as estruturas de dados adequadas (registros, matrizes, listas e grafos), aperfeiçoando e articulando saberes escolares.

components.description_pt: Construir solução computacional para problema selecionando estrutura de dados apropriada
components.description_en: Construct a computational solution to a problem selecting an appropriate data structure
components.cc_component_description: Select an appropriate data type—qualitative or quantitative—for a given investigation or design test

components.description_pt: Refinar solução computacional integrando conhecimento de diferentes áreas de aprendizado escolar
components.description_en: Refine a computational solution by integrating knowledge from different areas of school learning
components.cc_component_description: Refine a proposed solution based on evaluation results and new evidence

components.description_pt: Colaborar com pares para desenvolver e melhorar solução computacional para problema
components.description_en: Collaborate with peers to develop and improve a computational solution to a problem
components.cc_component_description: Apply iterative design cycle steps to develop and refine a solution to a defined problem

components.description_pt: Justificar a escolha de estrutura de dados usada em solução computacional para problema dado
components.description_en: Justify the choice of data structure used in a computational solution to a given problem
components.cc_component_description: Justify the selection of a preferred design solution based on systematic evaluation evidence

cc_matches.description: Decide when to use qualitative vs. quantitative data.
Undertake a design project, engaging in the design cycle, to construct and/or implement a solution that meets specific design criteria and constraints.
Evaluate competing design solutions using a systematic process to determine how well they meet the criteria and constraints of the problem.
Design, evaluate, and/or refine a solution to a complex real-world problem, based on scientific knowledge, student-generated sources of evidence, prioritized criteria, and tradeoff considerations.
